name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Carry
description: Hold the bell BOTTOMS-UP in the rack (balanced over a vertical forearm) and walk. Keep the bell perfectly vertical, ribs down, shoulder packed, and brace the core against the tipping load. A loaded carry that trains grip, shoulder stability, and anti-tip core control at the same time. Light bell, short distances; stop and reset if the bell starts to tip.
